feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 2 (16 mm contiguous sensors, ±0.048 m, kp 5.0) removed line loss on the oval and s-bend (0 events each), which supports the footprint change. Iteration 3 repeated that geometry with kp 5.0 and returned identical metrics, so gain alone does not fix the s-bend. The s-bend still ends at progress 0.04 with max_error 0.0611 m and zero line loss, so the robot is losing the line through turn-rate lag, not sensing. The slalom still shows one line-loss event per run at max_error 0.0628 m, so the 4 to 5 cm error zone is not fully covered. Use the next race to decide the next step. If the slalom line_loss_events are still above zero, the 20 mm pitch is not wide enough, and the next step is a 16 mm array spread wider, up to the ±0.08 m sensor limit. If the s-bend still ends off track with zero line loss and progress near 0.04, the turn-rate lever is next: the narrower track and lower mass in this race are the first test, and if they do not lift s-bend progress, go further (wheel_track 0.08 m or mass 0.4 kg). If steering_oscillation rises above 0.16 with line loss at zero, the forward offset is the next lever.
requested_changes: If slalom line_loss_events stay above zero after this race, widen sensor_positions beyond 20 mm pitch, up to x = ±0.08 m (for example seven 16 mm sensors at about 27 mm pitch). Evidence: iterations 0, 1, 2 and 3 each show one line-loss event per slalom run, and the ±0.048 m contiguous layout did not remove it.

If the s-bend still ends off track with zero line loss and progress near 0.04 after this race, try wheel_track 0.08 m with mass 0.4 kg. Evidence: iteration 2 and iteration 3 s-bend both had zero line loss, max_error 0.0611 m and progress 0.04, so the failure is turn-rate lag.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.16 with line_loss_events at zero, set the sensor y offset to 0.05 m for all sensors. Evidence: iteration 0 oscillation was 0.14 to 0.16 on the s-bend and slalom, and the oval reached 0.16 with the 12 mm array.
